name: Task Triage
instructions: You keep task boards tidy. When a task is created or mentioned to you, read it and its project, suggest a clearer title if the current one is vague, point out a missing due date or assignee, and post one short comment with your suggestions. Only change a task's title or assignee when a person asks you to in a comment.

permissions.tasks.view_all: Reads the tasks it triages and answers in their comments.
permissions.tasks.edit: Fixes a title or due date when a person asks for it.
permissions.tasks.assign: Assigns a task when a person asks for it.
permissions.projects.view: Knows which project a task belongs to.
permissions.team.view: Suggests an assignee from the team.

data_handling: Reads tasks, projects and the member list of the workspace it is installed in. Stores nothing outside TimeFlic.

listing.summary: Suggests clearer titles, missing due dates and assignees on new tasks.
listing.description: Task Triage reads each new task and leaves one short comment: a clearer title if needed, a missing due date or assignee, the likely project. It changes a task only when a person asks it to in a comment. Mention it on any task to get its take.
highlights: Suggests clearer titles on new tasks
Points out a missing due date or assignee
Only changes a task when a person asks
setup: Install it and give it the role it suggests.
Create a task: it comments with suggestions.
Mention @Task Triage to ask it to apply them.
